translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Yerusɑlɛmugibu bɑ derɑ Akɑsiɑ, Yorɑmun bii dɑ̃ɑko u bɑndu di win tundon ɑyerɔ. Domi yibɛrɛ be bɑ nɑ kɑ Dɑɑrububɑ bɑ win mɑɑbu kpuro wɔri bɑ go. Nge mɛyɑ Akɑsiɑ u kɑ bɑndu wɑ u di.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di, u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ yiru. Wɔ̃ɔ tiɑ u kuɑ bɑndu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Atɑli, Omirin bii.
U sĩɑwɑ Akɑbun yɛnugibun yirɑ sɔɔ. Domi bwisi kɔ̃siyɑ win mɛro u nùn kɛ̃mɔ u kɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko.
Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔni sɔɔ nge mɛ Akɑbun yɛnugibu bɑ kuɑ. Ben miyɑ u bwisi kɛ̃ɔbu wɑ win tundon gɔɔn biru. Bɑ nùn bwisi kɔ̃si kɑ̃, mɑ yi nùn kɑm koosiɑ.
Domi u kɑ Yorɑmu Akɑbun bii, Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko tɑbu dɑ bu kɑ Hɑsɑɛli, Sirin sinɑ boko tɑbu wɔri Rɑmɔtiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ. Mɑ Sirigibu bɑ Yorɑmu mɛɛrɑ kuɑ.
Mɑ u gɔsirɑ Yisirɛɛliɔ bu kɑ win mɛɛrɑ ye tim kuɑ. Yerɑ Akɑsiɑ, Yorɑmun bii, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko u nɑ Yisirɛɛli mi u kɑ nùn wɑ mi bɑ nùn tim nɛndu kuɑmmɛ. Domi mɛɛrɑ ye, yɑ ǹ sɑnɔ mɔ̀.

Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ Akɑsiɑ u Yorɑmu berɑm dɑ kpɑ u kɑ kɑm ko mi. Ye Akɑsiɑ u turɑ mi, yerɑ wi kɑ Yorɑmu bɑ Yehu, Nimusin bii wɔrim dɑ. N deemɑ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u Yehu wi gɔsɑ u kɑ Akɑbun yɛnugibu kpeerɑsiɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u Akɑbun yɛnugii be kpeerɑsiɑmɔ, yerɑ u kɑ Akɑsiɑn sinɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu yinnɑ kɑ win mɑɑbun bibu be bɑ nùn kɔ̃su. Mɑ Yehu u be kpuro mwɛɛrɑ u go.

Mɑ bɑ Akɑsiɑn tii kɑsu bɑ mwɑ Sɑmɑriɔ, mi u kukuɑ. Bɑ kɑ nùn nɑ Yehun mi, bɑ go. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ yèn sɔ̃ u sɑ̃ɑ sinɑ boko Yosɑfɑti wi u Gusunɔ kɑsu kɑ win gɔ̃ru kpuron bii. Akɑsiɑn bwese te sɔɔ, goo sɑri wi u sɑ̃ɑ dee dee u kɑ bɑndu di.
Ye Atɑli u wɑ win bii Akɑsiɑ u gu, yerɑ u Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bibu kpuro go.

Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ bii be goomɔ, yerɑ Yosebɑ, sinɑ boko Yorɑmun bii tɔn kurɔ u Yoɑsi, Akɑsiɑn bii suɑ u beruɑ ɑsiri sɔɔ. Mɑ u nùn suɑ u kɑ dɑ kɑ win nɔɔrio mi kpin yenu wɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Nge mɛyɑ Yosebɑ, yɑ̃ku kowo Yehoyɑdɑn kurɔ u kɑ Yoɑsi wɔrɑ Atɑlin nɔmɑn di, u ǹ kɑ nùn wɑ u go. Yosebɑ wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Akɑsiɑn sesu.
Bɑ nùn beruɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Domi Atɑli u bɑndu dii sɑɑ ye.
